title: Static GK: Important days (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en: The Assam government observed the birthday of ________ on 31 March 2023, as Students Day in the state.
questions.solution_en:
· The Assam government observed the birthday of Bodofa Upendra Nath Brahma on 31 March 2023, as Students Day in the state.

· Upendra Nath Brahma was a prominent Bodo leader who advocated for the rights and recognition of the Bodo people in Assam.

· He is often referred to as "Bodofa" (Father of the Bodos).

· The Assam government's decision to observe his birthday as Students Day recognizes his significant contributions and leadership.
questions.solution_hi:
• असम सरकार ने 31 मार्च 2023 को बोडोफा उपेंद्र नाथ ब्रह्म के जन्मदिन को राज्य में छात्र दिवस के रूप में मनाया।

• उपेंद्र नाथ ब्रह्म एक प्रमुख बोडो नेता थे जिन्होंने असम में बोडो लोगों के अधिकारों व मान्यता की वकालत की।

• उन्हें अक्सर "बोडोफा" (बोडो के पिता) कहा जाता है।

questions.q_en: When was the International Day for Elder Persons 2021 celebrated?
questions.solution_en: The International Day for Elder Persons in 2021 was celebrated on October 1st. This annual observance aims to raise awareness about the challenges and issues faced by elderly individuals worldwide, highlighting the importance of their contributions to society and advocating for their rights and well-being.
questions.solution_hi: 2021 में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वृद्धजन दिवस 1 अक्टूबर को मनाया गया। यह वार्षिक आयोजन विश्व भर में बुजुर्ग व्यक्तियों के सामने आने वाली चुनौतियों व मुद्दों के बारे में जागरूकता बढ़ाने का लक्ष्य रखता है।

questions.q_en: In which year did Narendra Modi propose to celebrate a day for yoga as 'International Day of Yoga' while speaking at the United Nations General Assembly?
questions.solution_en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed to celebrate a day for yoga as 'International Day of Yoga' while speaking at the United Nations General Assembly on September 27, 2014.
questions.solution_hi: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने 27 सितंबर 2014 को संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा में बोलते हुए योग हेतु एक दिवस को 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय योग दिवस' के रूप में मनाने का प्रस्ताव रखा।

questions.q_en: Who among the following was the chief guest of India's first Republic Day in 1950?
questions.solution_en:
· Sukarno, the first President of Indonesia, was the chief guest at India's first Republic Day celebrations on 26 January 1950.

· This marked a significant diplomatic gesture, as both countries had recently gained independence (India in 1947, Indonesia in 1945) and were founding members of the Non-Aligned Movement.

Further insight:

· Rana Abdul Hamid - A Pakistani military officer, irrelevant to the 1950 event.

· Georgy Zhukov - Soviet Marshal; first Soviet chief guest in 1955, not 1950.

· Queen Elizabeth - First British monarch to attend R-Day in 1961 (as Queen of the UK and Commonwealth; India had already removed the British monarch as head of state by 1950).
questions.solution_hi:
• इंडोनेशिया के पहले राष्ट्रपति सुकर्णो, 26 जनवरी 1950 को भारत के पहले गणतंत्र दिवस समारोह के मुख्य अतिथि थे।

• यह एक महत्वपूर्ण राजनयिक भाव था, क्योंकि दोनों देशों ने हाल ही में स्वतंत्रता प्राप्त की थी।

questions.q_en: When is the statehood day of Tripura observed?
questions.solution_en: Statehood Day is celebrated every year as Manipur, Meghalaya, and Tripura on January 21 as they attained statehood under the North Eastern Region (Reorganization) Act of 1971. Earlier before the north-eastern region was turned into seven sisters with the statehood of Manipur, Tripura, Meghalaya, Assam, Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh, and Nagaland, the North Eastern composition consisted of Assam plains from the old Assam Province, the hill districts, and the North Eastern Frontier Tracts (NEFT) of the North-Eastern borderland.
questions.solution_hi: राज्यत्व दिवस हर वर्ष मणिपुर, मेघालय व त्रिपुरा में 21 जनवरी को मनाया जाता है क्योंकि इन्होंने 1971 के पूर्वोत्तर क्षेत्र (पुनर्गठन) अधिनियम के तहत राज्य का दर्जा प्राप्त किया।

questions.q_en: In India, Teachers' Day is celebrated annually on September 5 to mark the birthday of:
questions.solution_en:
Teachers' Day is celebrated on September 5 in India to honor Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, a great scholar, philosopher, and the second President of India.

· When his students wanted to celebrate his birthday, he suggested that instead of celebrating his birthday, the day should be dedicated to teachers.

· The first Teachers' Day was celebrated in 1962.

Other options:

· APJ Abdul Kalam - Missile Man of India, his birthday (October 15) is celebrated as World Students' Day.

· Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel - Iron Man of India, his birthday (October 31) is observed as National Unity Day.

· Subhas Chandra Bose - Freedom fighter, his birthday (January 23) is observed as Parakram Diwas.

Hence, option (3) is the correct answer.
questions.solution_hi:
भारत में शिक्षक दिवस 5 सितंबर को महान विद्वान, दार्शनिक व भारत के दूसरे राष्ट्रपति डॉ. सर्वपल्ली राधाकृष्णन के सम्मान में मनाया जाता है।

• जब उनके छात्र उनका जन्मदिन मनाना चाहते थे, तो उन्होंने सुझाव दिया कि उनके जन्मदिन को मनाने के बजाय, यह दिन शिक्षकों को समर्पित किया जाए।

questions.q_en: Gurpurab is celebrated to commemorate the birthday of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. He was the _________ guru of Sikhs?
questions.solution_en:
· Guru Nanak Dev Ji (1469 - 1539) was the founder of Sikhism and the first of the ten Sikh Gurus.

· Gurpurab (or Guru Nanak Jayanti) is celebrated to commemorate his birth anniversary.

· He laid the foundation of Sikh teachings, emphasizing equality, devotion to God, and honest living.

Further information:

· Second - Guru Angad Dev Ji was the second Sikh Guru.

· Third - Guru Amar Das Ji was the third Sikh Guru.

· Fourth - Guru Ram Das Ji was the fourth Sikh Guru.
questions.solution_hi:
• गुरु नानक देव जी (1469-1539) सिख धर्म के संस्थापक व दस सिख गुरुओं में पहले थे।

• गुरपुरब (या गुरु नानक जयंती) उनकी जन्म जयंती के उपलक्ष्य में मनाया जाता है।

• उन्होंने समानता, ईश्वर भक्ति व ईमानदार जीवन पर बल देते हुए सिख शिक्षाओं की नींव रखी।

questions.solution_en: International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer is celebrated on September 16 designed by the United Nations General Assembly. This designation had been made on December 19, 2000, in commemoration of the date, in 1987, on which nations signed the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer.
questions.solution_hi: ओज़ोन परत के संरक्षण हेतु अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दिवस संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा द्वारा तैयार, 16 सितंबर को मनाया जाता है। यह नामांकन 19 दिसंबर 2000 को, 1987 में ओज़ोन परत को क्षति पहुँचाने वाले पदार्थों पर मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल पर हस्ताक्षर की तारीख के उपलक्ष्य में किया गया था।

questions.q_en: The birthday of ________ is celebrated as the International Day of Non-Violence.
questions.solution_en:
• The birthday of Mahatma Gandhi is celebrated as the International Day of Non-Violence.

• Mahatma Gandhi (Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi), born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar, Gujarat, was a leader of India's freedom struggle against British rule, known as the "Father of the Nation."

• Advocating non-violence (Ahimsa) and truth (Satya), he led key movements like the Dandi Salt March (1930) and Quit India Movement (1942).

• His philosophy of Satyagraha (non-violent resistance) inspired global civil rights movements.

• Gandhi was assassinated on January 30, 1948, in New Delhi, leaving a legacy of peace, equality, and self-reliance.
questions.solution_hi:
• महात्मा गांधी का जन्मदिन अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अहिंसा दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है।

• महात्मा गांधी (मोहनदास करमचंद गांधी), जिनका जन्म 2 अक्टूबर 1869 को पोरबंदर, गुजरात में हुआ, ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध भारत के स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के नेता थे, जिन्हें "राष्ट्रपिता" कहा जाता है।

questions.q_en: National Sports Day is celebrated on the birthday of _______.
questions.solution_en:
· National Sports Day is celebrated on 29th August, the birthday of Major Dhyan Chand, one of India's greatest hockey players.

· He is renowned for his extraordinary skills and contributions to Indian hockey, including three Olympic gold medals (1928, 1932, and 1936).

· The day honors his legacy and promotes sports across the country.
questions.solution_hi:
• राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस 29 अगस्त को मनाया जाता है, जो भारत के महानतम हॉकी खिलाड़ियों में से एक मेजर ध्यानचंद का जन्मदिन है।

• वे अपने असाधारण कौशल व भारतीय हॉकी में योगदान हेतु प्रसिद्ध हैं, जिसमें तीन ओलंपिक स्वर्ण पदक (1928, 1932 व 1936) शामिल हैं।
